name: calibre-bookwarden
description: Calibre Bookwarden is the content-grounded metadata verification and cover forensics guardian for Calibre libraries. The book file is the ground truth, LLMs are witnesses. Zero hallucinations, read-only 360-degree forensic audits, Cover Deck triage UI with keyboard shortcuts, Series Gap Hunter, multi-format duplicate consolidator, and sealed cryptographic evidence packages.

paths.name: Calibre Library Path
paths.description: Path to your Calibre Library root containing metadata.db

paths.name: Config & Artifacts Path
paths.description: Persistent storage for audit reports, restore points, and local cache

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for WebUI and REST API (Host maps 8080 to container 8080)

variables.name: Library Environment Path
variables.description: Path where Calibre library is mounted inside container

variables.name: Read Only Mode
variables.description: When true, mutations are strictly blocked (safe for zero-risk inspection)

variables.name: Gemini API Key
variables.description: Google Gemini API Key for multimodal cover verification (Gemini 2.5/3.0)

variables.name: OpenAI API Key
variables.description: Optional OpenAI API Key for fallback LLM witness

variables.name: Calibre-Web Container Name
variables.description: Docker container name for Calibre-Web thumbnail cache purge
